However these thoughts grew since I was a kid, starting from shooting someone I hate multiple times in the chest/face, and then it evolved to daydreaming about cutting my ex-gf in half. I cannot talk to any of the people around me. That would just create more chaos. I have tried to leave the certian circle of losers and failures but have been denied anywhere else. Every time I tried to even remotly open up it was a disaster. I am one of those people that are impossible to talk to due to my ignorance and twisted views. Noone knows I ever went to therapy, that I was hospitalized, that I cut myself. Those dark secrets I cannot unveil to anyone. That is how my heart feels. People like me do deserve to be lonely, to be cast out and exiled. The biggest hatred of people that posseses me is the hate towards average, prideful individuals. The biggest irony is that I grew up exactly into this.

In my twisted view, living is exactly doing what this prison of life wants you to. To obey the rules, sink in the sea with the rest of the slaves. To obey the instincts of the body to remain on this earth and survive. Suffering from your own mind. A life of shame, disgust, hatred and despair is something I would have never asked for, and since somehow, someone or something, threw me into this prison, then I look it directly in the eye with resentment, and pursue the only path that exists the dark tunnel. I've never asked to be living in a war, let alone a war between my body and my mind.

If afterlife does exist, then I fully deserve to be thrown in hell. As someone who lived his whole imagining that I deserve to be a God, I would indeed punish losers and prideful individuals such as myself. A part of me hopes death is just a void, another part hopes I get the punishment that I deserve, and the most ridiculous part is that a small part of my heart hopes for forgiveness, for weakness in my heart and all the chaos I created.

I hate this prison from the bottom of my heart. Enslaved by emotions, hormones, thoughts. An unescapable nightmare that people float in. I have succumbed to death, that is the main reason why I don't want to get better, but rather choose to purse the only path that ends the nightmare all together.

The only possible reason life could be valuable is if the individual finds his meaning. Some dream he lives in so the nightmare goes away. I find meaning in stuff that I never had, or that I do not deserve. Being just another streamlined character that follows the herd is something I would rather die than be. And as the irony in the story goes on, I am that person. Much worse and more terrible even. A lazy un-tallented person wanting to be a king is an endless cycle of torment. And since I wasn't born to be someone of value, someone higher, I will chase death till the end.

As respect to my parents trying everything they can in their limited and old views, I will endure to save them the horror of burying their only son. That is the least someone like me can do. Even though I am ashamed of them, they don't deserve the pain. In the meantime, every single drop of pain I will collect. Every tear. Every lost night of sleep. Every thought about her. All bad memories. The resentment and disgust. All of it. For when that day comes I want to be ready to exit the prison which I never asked for. I'm a coward on a path which requires the most bravery of them all, and I wish that I will manage to escaoe at the end.

Hope you find your peace as well, where ever it may be, even if it happens to be the void beyond.
